not_read: state or completion artifacts for Hag

non_authority_statement: Candidate literary and structural evidence only. Every boundary is LOW and deferred_human_or_external_ai. No theology, canon, authorship, date, historicity, chronology, ethics, identity, fulfillment, covenant system, preferred witness, preferred reading, preferred translation, source tradition, graph, retrieval, reviewed-gold, or promotion authority.
routing_principle: Prefer the larger coherent dated address, speech-response movement, priestly inquiry, retrospective exhortation, and paired-oracle parent. Date formulas, messenger formulas, imperatives, rhetorical questions, reported response, divine stirring, audience changes, question-and-answer form, temporal retrospect, blessing pivot, and renewed word formulas are literary evidence only.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: first dated address with rebuke, response, and communal stirring
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The initial word provokes obedience and the messenger assurance leads into divine stirring; the speech and narrated response can be retained as one complete speech-response parent.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: second dated address of encouragement and promised glory
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: A renewed date and messenger formula introduce imperatives, comparative questions, reassurance, cosmic imagery, and a closing peace promise.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: third dated address with priestly inquiry, application, retrospect, and blessing pivot
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Two paired Torah questions ground the application; repeated backward-looking imperatives and the from-this-day blessing formula complete the movement.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: second same-day oracle of cosmic reversal and Zerubbabel address
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: A repeated word formula on the same date changes addressee and sustains one cosmic-overthrow oracle through the signet conclusion.
The repeated date and second word formula distinguish the two speeches while also preserving their shared same-day parent.

global_hot_zones.issue: The dated rebuke, reported obedience, messenger assurance, divine stirring, and work resumption can be divided at several speech-narrative seams.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep rebuke and response as two coherent units while preserving the complete first dated address as a speech-response parent.

global_hot_zones.issue: Reported obedience, the brief messenger oracle, divine stirring, and the later work date may support smaller units.
global_hot_zones.handling: Retain the response-and-stirring sequence together because the narration traces the address's reception through resumed work; preserve internal alternatives.

global_hot_zones.issue: Encouragement, covenantal reassurance language, cosmic shaking, nations imagery, glory, and peace allow internal strophes and invite theological adjudication.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep the dated encouragement oracle whole; infer no covenant system, identity, chronology, fulfillment, or preferred reading.

global_hot_zones.issue: The priestly questions, their application, crop retrospect, and blessing pivot could be separated.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve the inquiry-to-application logic and retrospective reversal as one rhetorical movement; decide no legal or theological conclusion.

global_hot_zones.issue: Two word formulas occur on the same day, supporting both distinct speeches and a paired-oracle parent.
global_hot_zones.handling: Separate at the renewed word formula and changed addressee in 2:20-21, but preserve 2:10-23 as the larger same-day alternative.

global_hot_zones.issue: Cosmic and political overthrow imagery culminates in a direct Zerubbabel signet oracle and invites identity and fulfillment decisions.
global_hot_zones.handling: Retain the whole oracle, record the addressee shift as form evidence, and defer identity, chronology, political referent, and fulfillment.

units.title: Dated rebuke and consider-your-ways summons
units.literary_form: dated messenger address with accusation, rhetorical contrast, repeated exhortation, and consequence catalogue
units.deciding_marker: The opening date and word formula introduce an address to the leaders; the people's postponement claim is answered by paired consider-your-ways imperatives and a concluding because-of-you consequence statement before narration reports the response.
units.rejected_alternative: Dividing at the first consider-your-ways formula, isolating the command to ascend and build, or absorbing the response in 1:12-15 into the speech.
units.risk: date formula, speaker mediation, audience, temple language, economic imagery, covenant allusion, divine agency, ethics, and chronology

units.title: Response, assurance, stirring, and resumed work
units.literary_form: obedience report with embedded messenger assurance and divine-stirring work resumption
units.deciding_marker: The leaders and remnant respond to the preceding voice; the messenger assurance, repeated stirring language, and dated arrival for work narrate the full reception sequence.
units.rejected_alternative: Isolating the obedience report, the I-am-with-you assurance, the stirring report, or the work-date notice as separate chunks.
units.risk: fear language, messenger formula, speaker attribution, divine agency, leadership, remnant identity, and chronological relation

units.title: Dated encouragement and glory promise
units.literary_form: dated encouragement oracle with comparative questions, triple imperatives, reassurance, cosmic shaking, and glory-peace closure
units.deciding_marker: A new date and word formula open a fresh address; questions about former appearance move into repeated be-strong and work commands, reassurance, shaking imagery, and a concluding declaration of later glory and peace.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating the comparative questions, encouragement and reassurance, cosmic-shaking passage, or glory-and-peace close into independent chunks.
units.risk: audience, chronology, memory, covenant language, Spirit language, nations and desire wording, textual translation, temple identity, glory, peace, and fulfillment

units.title: Priestly inquiry, retrospect, and blessing pivot
units.literary_form: dated disputation oracle with paired priestly questions, prophetic application, retrospective inventory, and temporal blessing reversal
units.deciding_marker: The third date and word formula initiate ask-the-priests questions and answers; then-so application leads to repeated consider-from-this-day-backward language, failed-harvest retrospect, and the terminal from-this-day-I-will-bless-you pivot.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating the two legal questions from their application, dividing at the retrospective command, or isolating the final blessing formula.
units.risk: priestly instruction, purity and contagion logic, legal application, communal identity, crop history, divine agency, chronology, translation, and blessing theology

units.title: Second same-day cosmic and Zerubbabel oracle
units.literary_form: renewed same-day messenger oracle with direct address, cosmic-political overthrow catalogue, and signet conclusion
units.deciding_marker: A second word formula explicitly occurs on the same day and redirects the address to Zerubbabel; repeated overthrow diction runs through the oracle to the in-that-day signet declaration and messenger close.
units.rejected_alternative: Merging both same-day oracles, separating cosmic shaking from political overthrow, or isolating the final direct-address signet saying.
units.risk: same-day sequencing, cosmic imagery, political entities, violence, agency, Zerubbabel identity, servant and signet language, election language, and fulfillment
